hooks.command: file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || true); root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if printf '%s\n' "$file_path" | grep -q '\.context/.*\.json$' && [ -d "$root/.context" ]; then printf '%s | TASK_TRANSITION | file=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$file_path" >> "$root/.context/audit.log" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
